entries.note: Conditional marriage, transfer by lot and inheritance; several Hebrew possessives realized by French relative clauses.
Jubilee and pronominal repetition: second inheritance is rendered by celui and il.
Speech formula implicit; idiom good in their eyes rendered vouloir.
Comparison and correlative construction condensed into se conformer.
Cognate oath and binding expressions; self reference implicit in reflexive pronoun.
Repeated possessive and self-binding clauses recast as French relative clauses.
Marriage with existing vows recast as prior action; implicit self-binding.
Implicit subject femme and self-binding formula.
Repeated pronominal object anticipates the list of vows; contextual rather than lexical.
Emphatic infinitive and repeated hearing formula; contextual possessives.
